QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Dark Undercurrents
QuestInfo.0: As Eremose analyzes the black organism samples from Gold Beach, he discovers something important.
QuestInfo.1: The black organisms in Gold Beach didn't aren't naturally occurring. The culprit behind this phenomenon must be defeated before the beach can return to normal. Confront the large octopus at Gold Beach and restore the beach to its former state.
QuestInfo.2: Gold Beach Seaside will soon be safer place thanks to your defeat of the octopus, but something is wrong with Surana.

default.0: How goes your training? Have you defeated that octopus yet?
